svg.aria-label: The cross-server lethal trifecta: web-fetcher reads untrusted pages, notes-reader reads private notes, and slack-notifier posts outside. None is a trifecta alone, but one agent connected to all three can be injected and made to exfiltrate.

svg.text: A prompt injection in a fetched page can make the agent read your notes

text.font-family: OFSans, 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and post them to Slack, though no single server could do that alone.
